content.text: At 8, night waking can flare up around school stress, big feelings, or just a shift in sleep cycles — it's not unusual but worth a look. Try a short wind-down ritual (same time every night, screens off 30-40 min before bed) and a quick chat during the day about anything on her mind, since anxiety that's quiet at dinner often surfaces at 2am. If it's been more than a couple of weeks with no let-up, worth mentioning to her doctor at the next visit.
